event.text: You can follow the ibuprofen package label for adult dosing and duration, taking it with food and using it for the shortest time you need; your sprain is improving, so pain relief plus rest and gradual activity is reasonable. Message a clinician here if you need it beyond about a week, if pain or swelling worsens, if you can't bear weight, or if you get stomach pain, black stools or you have kidney, ulcer, asthma or pregnancy concerns.
